links.outcome: Confidence calibration of LLM self-reported certainty on gastroenterology board-style questions (Brier score, AUROC)
links.effect: All 48 models showed poor certainty estimation. Even the best-calibrated models had substantial overconfidence (Brier 0.15-0.2, AUROC ~0.6). Models stayed highly certain regardless of question difficulty.
links.quote: Even the best-calibrated systems (o1 preview, GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet) showed substantial overconfidence (Brier scores 0.15-0.2, AUROC ~0.6).

screen.reason: Evaluates confidence calibration across 48 LLMs on gastroenterology board exam-style questions without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
